🥊 NOOB EXPERIMENT: WARZONE

Fight through relentless waves of enemies in an action-packed co-op experience inspired by Noob Experiment Battlefront, Blockade Battlefront, and Ultra Toilet Fight 2.

⚔️ Play as iconic characters from Flippidee's Noob Experiment universe, each featuring completely unique abilities and designs. Survive increasingly difficult waves for as long as you can solo or with your team.

📖 Update Log:
Mini Update: Spooky Mode (10/30)
Mini Update: Crossroads & GM UPD (10/21)
Mini Update: Modifiers (10/3)
Mini Update: Optimizations & Buffs (8/15)
Big Update: Rework & Guest Mech Update (8/14)

🔥 Features
• Easy Mode
• Medium Mode
• Boss Fights
• Sandbox Mode
• Fun Progression of characters and enemies
• Frequent Updates

🎮 Recommended: Private Servers for the best experience. Rewards are shared between all players in a server.

👍 LIKE & FAVORITE to support future updates!

💬 Join the community:
https://www.roblox.com/communities/35604045/untitled-group-i-guess
